reading.body:
Liquid coolant temperature and flow rate track the supply and return temperature and flow rate of a coolant loop, whether direct-to-chip cold plates or full immersion baths.

At AI rack densities, the coolant loop is described as the machine's life support, flow loss or a supply-temperature excursion can damage hardware in seconds to minutes, far faster than an air-cooled room degrades under a comparable fault, which makes this a much less forgiving failure mode than the temperature and humidity monitoring used in air-cooled facilities. Facility water loops commonly deliver warmer supply temperatures than comfort cooling systems do, which is part of why liquid cooling improves a facility's overall PUE.

It groups with temperature and humidity and airflow and static pressure under Cooling and climate, and stands out among that group as the metric specifically tied to the liquid-cooling infrastructure that dense AI racks increasingly require rather than to conventional air-cooled rooms.
